<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Expose optional, request-level prefill work snapshots on the Rust gRPC `GenerateStream`, allowing routing clients to update in-flight work while prefill runs.

Closes #63140. Related: Router [colocated #444](https://github.com/vllm-project/router/pull/444), [P/D #469](https://github.com/vllm-project/router/pull/469), and [design RFC #294](https://github.com/vllm-project/router/issues/294).

[#40371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/40371) exposes prompt progress to Python OpenAI streaming clients; this PR adds a Rust gRPC signal for routing consumers.

## Claims

- `GetServerInfo.supports_prefill_progress` advertises support. A client opts in with `GenerateRequest.include_prefill_progress`; progress arrives separately from generated output as sequenced `GenerateResponse.prefill_progress` snapshots. New snapshots replace the previous remaining-work estimate.
- Snapshots report remaining prompt work and cache accounting. An initial queued snapshot can have `cache_accounting_final=false`, because prefix reuse has not yet been reconciled. Pending remote KV is not credited until usable; remaining work can increase after preemption or recomputation.
- The scheduler throttles ordinary decreases and targets a one-second refresh while it is active. The engine keeps one pending pure-progress snapshot per request; newer progress may replace older progress without dropping ordinary output, metadata, or finish events.
- The flag defaults to false. Unsupported workers can be detected through capability discovery; unary `Generate` rejects the opt-in. See [usage and examples](https://github.com/KaisennHu/vllm/blob/d16847dafe120afd3ca7e90311e71c3f2ae665f9/docs/serving/prefill_progress.md).

## Validation

- **Current HEAD `d16847d`:** `cargo +1.95.0 build --locked --release -p vllm-cmd --bin vllm-rs` passed from `rust/`. A live 4-worker gRPC replay completed **730/730 requests** with progress off and on; both runs reported **56,570,112 input and 552,859 output tokens**. This checks successful serving and token counts, not token-by-token output equivalence.
- **Historical tests, before the latest main sync and streaming fix:** Python scheduler/serialization/cache selections **25 passed**; Rust engine-core client, gRPC server, and LLM generation suites **165 / 73 / 14 passed**. Ruff, Rust formatting, Clippy, and applicable pre-commit hooks passed. These counts are not a full test claim for `d16847d`.
- **Output quality:** a historical B300 warm-prefix smoke test matched progress-off/on output and reused 2,032 tokens in each run. Cold and warm runs differed by one token even with progress disabled; the cause was not established. No broader model evaluation has been run on the current HEAD.
- **CI at `d16847d`:** proto, semver, and DCO checks passed. The [pre-run check](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/41572755932/job/125709237251) failed the repository's contributor/label gate, so pre-commit was skipped; the [docs build](https://app.readthedocs.org/projects/vllm/builds/35601605/) stopped at that same gate.

<details>
<summary>Historical test commands</summary>

```bash
uv run --active --no-project python -m pytest tests/v1/test_serial_utils.py tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py tests/v1/core/test_async_scheduler.py -q -k 'prefill_progress or abort_request_when_structured_output_fsm_cannot_advance'
uv run --active --no-project python -m pytest tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py -q -k frontend_block_hashes
uv run --active --no-project python -m pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py -q -k failed_load_rezeroes_unwritten_skipped_blocks
```

From `rust/`:

```bash
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo test --locked --release -p vllm-engine-core-client --lib
cargo test --locked --release -p vllm-server --lib grpc
cargo test --locked --release -p vllm-llm --test generate
cargo clippy --locked --release -p vllm-engine-core-client -p vllm-llm -p vllm-server --all-targets -- -D warnings
```

</details>

### Downstream performance: preliminary C4

One off/on pair with Router #444 `cf5bc54`, this PR `d16847d`, Qwen3-4B BF16, four colocated B300 workers, and an [AgentX-style replay](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/agent-infer/blob/main/docs/zh/how-to/run-trace-replay.md) of 32 sessions / 730 requests derived from [WekaTrace](https://huggingface.co/datasets/semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126/tree/23f152f6f0f9399a85901b89a6458def0ef16729):

| Off → on | Worker prefill mean | Client TTFT mean | Total token/s | Session JCT mean |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| C4 | 178.71 → 176.17 ms **(−1.42%)** | 198.88 → 196.05 ms **(−1.42%)** | 80,134 → 80,665 **(+0.66%)** | 86.27 → 86.15 s **(−0.14%)** |

Output throughput was 775.57 → 780.71 token/s (+0.66%). Cache hit rate (93.03%) and newly computed prompt tokens (3,943,216) were unchanged. Other GPUs were active on the shared host. This single pair evaluates the combined Router/worker system; it does not establish a stable gain or its cause. Higher concurrency and repeats are in progress.

## Details and limits

Remaining tokens are a work estimate, not a latency prediction. Refresh depends on scheduler activity, and receipt time does not establish sample age. The single progress slot bounds additional pure-progress buffering, not the existing lossless model-output FIFO. Consumers must handle stale updates and clean up on completion, error, or cancellation.

AI assistance was used in preparing this PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+# Prefill Progress over gRPC
+
+The experimental Rust frontend can report the remaining prefill work for each
+request. Progress is disabled by default and is available through the
+`vllm.Inference/GenerateStream` gRPC API.
+
+## Start the server
+
+Start the Rust frontend with a gRPC port:
+
+```bash
+VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B \
+  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --grpc-port 50051
+```
+
+## Request progress
+
+From the vLLM repository root, use [grpcurl](https://github.com/fullstorydev/grpcurl)
+to check whether the server supports progress:
+
+```bash
+grpcurl -plaintext -import-path rust/proto -proto control.proto \
+  -d '{}' localhost:50051 vllm.Control/GetServerInfo
+```
+
+If `supportsPrefillProgress` is true, set `include_prefill_progress` on a
+streaming request:
+
+```bash
+grpcurl -plaintext -import-path rust/proto -proto inference.proto \
+  -d '{"request_id":"example","text":"Explain KV caching.","include_prefill_progress":true,"stopping":{"max_new_tokens":16}}' \
+  localhost:50051 vllm.Inference/GenerateStream
+```
+
+If the capability is unavailable, omit the flag and use the normal stream.
+Unary `Generate` does not accept the flag.
+
+## Consume updates
+
+- Read `prefillProgress` responses alongside the normal `outputs` responses.
+  For each request, replace the previous estimate with the newest `sequence`
+  and `remainingComputeTokens`; do not add snapshots together.
+- Remaining work can increase after preemption or recomputation. When
+  `cacheAccountingFinal` is false, cache-hit counts are not yet confirmed.
+- Track update freshness and release request reservations on completion, error,
+  or cancellation, even if no final progress update arrives.
+
+See the [gRPC protocol](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/main/rust/proto)
+for the schema and client bindings.

+def test_prefill_progress_emits_prefill_stats_once(

+    for _ in range(4 + max_tokens - 1):
+        scheduled = scheduler.schedule()
+        sampled = request.num_computed_tokens >= request.num_prompt_tokens
+        batches = scheduler.update_from_output(
+            scheduled,
+            ModelRunnerOutput(
+                req_ids=[request.request_id],
+                req_id_to_index={request.request_id: 0},
+                sampled_token_ids=[[1] if sampled else []],
+                logprobs=None,
+                prompt_logprobs_dict={},
+                pooler_output=[],
+            ),
+        )
+        outputs.extend(output for batch in batches.values() for output in batch.outputs)
+
+    progress_outputs = [output for output in outputs if not output.new_token_ids]
+    assert bool(progress_outputs) == include_prefill_progress
+    assert all(output.prefill_progress is not None for output in progress_outputs)
+    assert all(output.prefill_stats is None for output in progress_outputs)
+    if include_prefill_progress:
+        progress = progress_outputs[0].prefill_progress
+        assert progress.total_compute_tokens == 64
+        assert progress.remaining_compute_tokens == 48
+    token_outputs = [output for output in outputs if output.new_token_ids]
+    assert len(token_outputs) == max_tokens
+    assert token_outputs[0].prefill_stats is not None
+    assert token_outputs[0].prefill_stats.num_computed_tokens == 64
+    assert all(output.prefill_stats is None for output in token_outputs[1:])
+    assert token_outputs[-1].finish_reason == FinishReason.LENGTH

+    assert prefill is not None

+    assert prefill.remaining_compute_tokens == 80
+
+    decode = Scheduler._make_prefill_progress(request, None, True, None, 0.01)
+    assert decode is not None
+    assert decode.phase == 4  # DECODE
+    assert decode.total_compute_tokens == 80
+    assert decode.remaining_compute_tokens == 0
+
